Description: A cowboy toy gets jealous when a flashy new space toy becomes his owner's favorite.
A worried father crosses the ocean looking for his son, who ends up in a dentist's fish tank.
A creature who likes living alone has to rescue a princess to get his home back.
A computer hacker learns that the world around him is not what it seems.
Two young people from different social classes fall in love aboard a ship that sinks.
Visitors tour an island attraction where scientists brought ancient animals back to life.
A child gets left behind during a family vacation and defends the house from burglars.
A young lion runs away after his father dies and later returns to face his uncle.
A teenager travels into the past and accidentally interferes with his parents meeting.
A family hiding their special powers has to work together to stop a villain.
A masked crime fighter faces a criminal who causes chaos and forces difficult choices.
A lonely trash-collecting robot on an abandoned Earth meets a visiting robot.
A man reporting on a small-town holiday keeps waking up to the exact same day.
A farmhand sets out to reunite with a woman he loves while a grandfather reads the adventure to a child.
The movie my cousin told me about over the phone but I forgot what he said.
